title: Learning Director — capability roadmap
north_star: Converge winner-picking (top) and loser-filtering (bottom) into a bettable model: progressively narrow the eligible pool into a mostly-decent cohort, then allocate sleeves — with regime monitoring so assumptions expire safely.

prediction_philosophy.primary_aim: Predict future growth in value of individual stocks — not perfect historical explanation.
prediction_philosophy.useful_patterns: Changes in trajectory that indicate when to update opinion on a stock (upgrade, downgrade, exclude, re-enter).
prediction_philosophy.not_the_goal: Achieving a perfect understanding of past behaviour or static level-fit on history.
signal_types: timing_overlay — wait/buy timing changes on names already on the radar
cohort_drift — buy-tier quality floor rising or falling week-on-week
exclusion_trigger — loser signature appearing before price damage compounds
exit_trajectory — deterioration in hold thesis before full avoid/downgrade (timing overlay flip, conviction decay, sector-relative weakness)
prediction_philosophy.exit_philosophy: Same trajectory-change lens as entry: exit when opinion should flip, not when a static stop or calendar rule fires. Hold-to-breakeven vs swap-success cohorts measure whether waiting or rotating was the right opinion update.

portfolio_shape.hypothesis: Deployable end state may be a broad book of proportionally small sleeves (many names, equal or capped weights), not a concentrated 3-position hero portfolio.
portfolio_shape.index_edge_mechanism: Removing a handful of poor performers can dominate index excess — asymmetric damage from left-tail losers vs right-tail winners.
portfolio_shape.base_rate: Some underperformers are an irreducible consequence of prediction; optimise minimise-rate and speed-of-exit, not zero-error classification.
success_metrics: cohort excess after costs vs benchmark

prediction_philosophy.evaluation_bias: Prefer forward-looking change detectors and opinion-flip precision over in-sample R² or narrative backstory fit.

convergence_thesis.bottom_filter: Raise the floor — exclude recurrent loser signatures before concentration.
convergence_thesis.top_pick: Among survivors, allocate sleeves by conviction, sector caps, and research overlay.
convergence_thesis.primary_metric: Filtered cohort excess (gross then net) before hero 3-position P&L.
convergence_thesis.bet_gate: Promote only when cohort floor, retain rate, and deployable book agree over extending windows.

complexity_budget.note: Director should recommend retire/merge/defer when budget exceeded.

phases.label: Weekly Learning Director prompt
phases.summary: Read-only weekly synthesis: regime check, convergence narrative, experiment inventory, vision roadmap review.

phases.label: Rolling regime slices (8 / 16 / 24 weeks)
phases.summary: Deterministic rollups comparing exclusion alpha, cohort hit rate, and exclude/retain rates across extending windows; flag decay and reversals.
phases.revisit_when: history_run_count >= 16 and exclusion archive has >= 12 consecutive week pairs

phases.label: Filtered cohort paper track (15–20 EW sleeves)
phases.summary: Deploy ladder-filtered buy-tier as equal-weight cohort track; measure cohort excess separately from 3-pos primary.
phases.revisit_when: u4 exclusion alpha positive over full sample AND exclusion_ladder_replay ready_for_shadow_spawn true for >= 4 weeks

phases.label: Loser pattern lab (feature attribution)
phases.summary: PIT feature store on bottom-quartile buy-tier names; propose human-readable exclusion rules mapped to knobs/overlays.

phases.label: Automated filter invention search
phases.summary: Search filter combinations maximising exclude_rate subject to top-quartile retain floor and minimum pool size.
phases.revisit_when: loser_pattern_lab has >= 3 validated patterns with stable out-of-sample exclude lift

phases.label: Dual-objective knob ranking
phases.summary: Blend exclude_rate and catch_rate in calibration/endurance, not winner-only cohort fitness.

phases.label: Auto-promote experiments to engineering
phases.summary: Never default — human promote gates remain. Revisit only if triage load is unsustainable.

guardrails.auditable_rule_set: Deployable end state must remain inspectable: named screen signals, explicit knob config, documented exclusion ladder steps, and human-readable research memos — not opaque model weights or undisclosed filters.

evidence_balance.winner_research: Research memos target strong_buy/buy (+ alumni who left buy tier). Supports accumulate gate on AI track.
evidence_balance.avoid_gap: Avoid-tier names (~40+ per screen) carry quantitative signals only — no systematic qualitative forensics. Denies evidence on whether avoids were right, what loser signatures recur, and how thesis deterioration presents.
evidence_balance.director_role: Learning Director should flag this imbalance in weekly synthesis and propose observe-only steps (e.g. loser_pattern_lab, selective avoid forensics) — not expand memo spend without human ack.
